_comment: One line per scene, spoken over it. Each line says what the scene shows and nothing more -- the narration is held to the same rule as the captions, so a listener who cannot read the screen is told the same truths, including what is mock and what is not built. `lead` is seconds after the cut before the voice starts.

lines.Hook: Cost visibility for accounts that were never an Organization.
lines.Problem: Independent accounts, no payer rollup. And cost data not everyone may see.
lines.Product: One view over every account: a year of spend, five accounts, ten services. Mock data, not live spend.
lines.Rbac: The same screen, a different identity. One grant, one account. The rest were never returned.
lines.Predicate: Every cost query carries this predicate. Measured against the deployed database: full access, one account, one service, then nothing.
lines.Proof: Two real accounts. One answered with real service names; the other was refused at the cost call, and told us what to check.
lines.Cost: It bills itself: zero dollars so far, on one small database and five functions.
lines.Deploy: One command stands it up. Fifty-seven resources, no servers to patch.
lines.Scale: An account is a row. A provider is one adapter. Google Cloud is not built yet.
lines.Close: CostHub. Cost data people can share without over-sharing.
